title: data of a key.revoke envelope, signed with the key it revokes

revoked_key.description: The key declared compromised: the sender's current key, which signs the envelope.

replacement.description: The key that replaces the revoked one; absent when the revocation only removes authority.

next_key_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the 32-byte public key that will follow new_key.

proof.description: JWS typ paseka-key-replacement+jwt, kid new_key, payload per key-replacement.schema.json.
